# Wavecorp Project Instructions

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.
- [x] Clarify project requirements: Vite, React, TypeScript, one-page institutional website.
- [x] Scaffold the project in the current workspace folder.
- [x] Customize the project with the Wavecorp content and visual identity.
- [x] Install required extensions: none required.
- [x] Compile the project and resolve diagnostics.
- [x] Run the development server from the package script.
- [x] Launch and visually validate the project.
- [x] Ensure README and project documentation are complete.

## Development Guidelines

- Keep the website responsive and accessible.
- Use React, TypeScript, CSS, and Lucide icons.
- Preserve the one-page information architecture.
- Keep communication and implementation focused.
